expandedSheet.construction: nearest-neighbour upscale of four native frames

notes: Recovery checkpoint 2026-10-23: the four native frames were extracted from the preserved high-resolution male Brujo idle source in the Library archive.

The original reference has an opaque checkerboard baked into the RGB pixels. Background pixels were flood-filled from the image edge and the four connected character components were preserved, scaled into 32x64 cells and aligned to a common foot baseline.
The resulting 128x64 native strip uses an indexed 63-colour palette and transparent index 0. Frame RGBA hashes are recorded in nativeFrames.frameHashesRgba.

The expanded 256x128 strip in this path was unreadable and must be regenerated by scripts/reparar-staging-tier2.py from this verified native strip. Artistic approval remains pending and runtimeApproved is false.
